input.title: 50bb · Paired river
input.description: A 12bb river pot on Qs 9h 6c 2d 2s. BB acts first with 44bb behind. Half-pot, pot, all-in, and one subsequent raise are modeled.
input.rangeAssumptions: Illustrative study ranges, not inferred or certified preflop ranges. Every unblocked exact combination in each listed hand class has equal starting weight. Rake-free Home game. Player 0 is BTN; player 1 is BB.
